facts.title: NOK translation is not investment alpha
facts.text: NBIM reports returns in NOK and in its benchmark currency basket. Changes in NOK affect the reported NOK result but do not, by themselves, change the fund's international purchasing power.
facts.dateMeaning: Source verified on this date; this is a methodological statement, not a market observation.

facts.title: A hedge can protect value and demand liquidity
facts.text: In Norges Bank's survey of 10 Norwegian asset managers, a hypothetical sudden 20% NOK depreciation implied NOK 104 billion of variation margin at 2025 Q1, against approximately NOK 680 billion of hedged assets. This is an industry survey scenario, not NBIM's margin requirement or an observed cash outflow.
facts.dateMeaning: Survey reference quarter end; the stated cash requirement is conditional on a stress scenario.

facts.title: Assess value, concentrations and liquidity together
facts.text: NBIM's market-risk policy covers absolute and benchmark-relative risk using concentration, volatility and correlation, factor, and liquidity dimensions. Its policy calls for several approaches and regular stress testing.
facts.source: Norges Bank Investment Management, Market Risk Management policy
facts.dateMeaning: Last-updated date displayed on the policy; verified 24 November 2026.

nbimBridge.source: Norges Bank Investment Management, Strong return in 2025
nbimBridge.note: Published calendar-2025 fund totals in NOK billions, rounded by the source. Accounting return + FX translation + inflow after management costs = change in fund value. The 15.1% reported return is a return measure, not the percentage change in the NOK fund value. This historical bridge supplies no current portfolio holdings or trading signal.

provenance.normalization: NOK per one foreign currency unit = source OBS_VALUE / 10**UNIT_MULT
provenance.referenceQuoteNote: Indicative reference middle rates, not executable bid/ask quotes. Source collection field refers to the ECB concertation time of 14:15; Norges Bank daily publication is approximately 16:00 local time. Observation date and download time are distinct.
provenance.sourceVintage: Latest source vintage on the recorded retrieval dates. Historical corrections may revise a later download; this is not an archived point-in-time data set.
provenance.researchSeparation: The v2 EUR/NOK model remains frozen through October 2026. Updated reference quotes and historical replays here do not rerun or validate that forecasting model.
provenance.holdingsNote: This file supplies no portfolio holdings. Any dashboard demo holdings and contract terms are illustrative user assumptions, never observed exposures.
